data.scope: diagnostic sampled native OS counters only, never exact scheduler events or benchmark evidence
data.initial_coverage: first successful snapshot; startup before it is not event-traced
data.timing_clock: perf_counter_ns; legacy monotonic_ns is distinct and must not be joined to QPC
data.flush_policy: flush each JSON line; no fsync/power-loss guarantee

data.io_scope: includes console and diagnostic IPC; not file/physical-disk latency
data.thread_enumeration: one initial Toolhelp snapshot only; owned live thread handles retained and queried thereafter
data.thread_coverage: initial captured threads only; later/background threads are not discovered or attributed
data.thread_identity: owner checked on acquisition; pinned handle and creation time checked on every query

initial_thread_snapshot.coverage: initial snapshot only; new/background threads remain uncovered
